_comment: Single source of truth for page metadata. JSON on purpose: the React app imports it (src/shared/seo.js) AND the post-build script reads it with require() (scripts/build-seo.js), so the tags crawlers see in the raw HTML and the tags the SPA sets on client-side navigation can never drift apart. Titles are kept under ~60 characters and descriptions 140-160 so Google shows them whole.
